title: MS-BDTT reproducibility package: Digital Twin Transfer for Marine Power Fault Diagnosis via Continuous Domain Interpolation (confirmatory revision)
description: Complete reproducibility package for the revised manuscript. Contains: (i) source code of all three MS-BDTT stages and all ten baselines with the exact hyperparameter configurations; (ii) split manifests (CSV, SHA-256 checksummed, one row per window with parent record/bearing/trajectory and partition, including transformed S2 records); (iii) exact random seeds and per-run command lines; (iv) trained model weights; (v) run-level predictions and per-run metrics underlying every mean, confidence interval and test statistic; (vi) raw per-scenario per-stage MMD logs; (vii) one regeneration script per table and figure; (viii) the scripted confirmatory analyses: ten-seed paired replication, S4 open-set evaluation, retention and budget sweeps, identifiability diagnostics, degradation-boundary labelling, and the manifest generation and leakage-check toolkit.
